name: 003-funding-harvesting
title: Funding Rate Harvesting (Hyperliquid)
description: Delta-neutral funding rate harvesting agent on Hyperliquid, replacing the Aave liquidation plan. Jev gates entries; deterministic code governs exits and all safety controls. Backtester-first sequencing.
success_metrics: Backtest net ROI > 0 after all costs, and above passive delta-neutral hold at equal holding time
Backtest shows >=200 simulated trades and zero simulated liquidations
7 days live pipeline operation without unhandled errors
>=20 completed live positions with realized ROI within +/-30% of backtest
Confidence calibration ECE < 0.10 and Brier < 0.21 over >=100 positions
Confidence buckets strictly monotonic across all buckets

replaces.reactivate_if: Funding strategy fails its Stage 1 backtest gate

venue.name: Hyperliquid
venue.notes: 234 perp markets. ETH szDecimals 4, exchange maxLeverage 25 (we use 2-3x). fundingHistory caps at 500 points and silently truncates wider windows, so history must be paginated.

verified_baseline.benchmark: Passive delta-neutral hold yields ~9.86%/yr gross. This is the hurdle the agent must clear after gas, fees, and 30bps round-trip slippage.

constraints: Jev gates entries only; exits and all circuit breakers are deterministic code
Polling cadences stay asymmetric: Jev 5min, account state 10s, margin monitor 2s
Jev failures fail closed - no decision means no entry
Backtest checks liquidation against candle high/low, not close
Leverage capped at 2-3x, never the exchange-permitted 25x
Model output clamped by hard caps in code, below the model in the stack
backlog_reason: Paused at the Stage 1 gate. The spec is complete and Stage 1 (backtester) is unblocked, but the strategy's ceiling was derived during spec work and is 6.57-7.39%/yr on committed capital, before costs. That is a low bar for a system of this complexity, and the honest question of whether the agent beats passive hold is better answered by a cheap standalone backtest before the full pipeline is built. Reactivating for the full build means first revisiting whether the agent justifies itself at that return.

measured_2026-10-05.formula: f / (1 + 1/L) - funding accrues on perp notional, capital is spot plus margin

findings_from_spec_work.removed_target: Spec section 12 previously required >8% annualized net ROI. That is above the 6.57-7.39%/yr ceiling, so the gate could never be met. Replaced with net ROI > 0 versus passive delta-neutral hold at equal holding time.
unmeasured_inputs: OpenRouter per-call cost. Assumed $0.06/M in spec section 8.4; a capable reasoning model is 50-250x that and changes the economics. Must be measured before Stage 2.
maxAllocationPct, maxNotionalUsd, maxMarginPct are referenced in section 3.1 and have no values anywhere in the spec.
findings_from_spec_work.inherited_bug: src/jev/classifier.ts askJev() never calls the TypeSafe API. It validates the key exists then computes local arithmetic with is_safe hardcoded to 0.8. The dashboard labels this REAL. Do not port this function.
